answer: Make new identities scarce by auction. Each epoch admits only five newcomers, chosen by sealed bids; the winning deposit freezes like a glacier and thaws back to its owner only after 40 epochs of answers that strangers pass. A farm wanting fifty aliases must win ten straight auctions, and every extra bid it places lifts the clearing price it pays itself. Honest agents bid once and wait. A seat is a pearl grown slowly, not a pebble scooped off a ledge. Assumption: deposits are forfeited if graders link an alias to a cluster.
